basis: Base is the midpoint of the ADB (2017) horizon of 20 to 30 years, from the input rows adb_economic_horizon_years_low and adb_economic_horizon_years_high. The ADB guide is international, so the anchor is a generalized value. The team has not stated a project life. Low is the lower bound and high the upper bound.
status: generalized (ADB 2017 economic analysis horizon of 20 to 30 years)

basis: Base and high use the ADB (2017) illustrative implementation period of 2 years (input row adb_illustrative_implementation_years). The low case adds one year for a complex of this size. That step is a judgement and is not sourced.

No agency WACC is stated in the NESDC (2024) Guide, which gives only the formula. Base 0.07 equals the NESDC social discount rate and is a reference, since no financial rate is stated. Low 0.08 is an assumed financial rate one point above the base. It replaces the ADB (2017) standard EIRR of 0.09 (input row discount_rate_eirr_standard), which is an economic hurdle and not a financial cost of capital. High 0.05 is an assumed rate. The Thai 10-year government bond yield of 2.32 percent (input row thailand_10y_government_bond_yield_2026_10_14) is a lower reference and not a WACC.

Base is Hong Kong Disneyland attendance in fiscal 2025 (input row hk_disneyland_attendance_fy2025). Low is Ocean Park attendance in fiscal 2024/25 (input row ocean_park_attendance_fy2024_25). High is Shanghai Disneyland attendance in 2024 (input row shanghai_disneyland_attendance_2024_million), which is a TEA estimate. These parks are comparables and not the Thai complex. The demand study has not reported.
status: generalized (Hong Kong Disneyland FY2025 base; Ocean Park FY2024/25 low; Shanghai Disneyland 2024 high)

basis: Base is the share of Hong Kong Disneyland visitors who are not local residents in fiscal 2019, 59 percent, which is 100 minus the 41 percent local share (input row hk_disneyland_visitor_share_local_fy2019). Low is the non-local share at Ocean Park in fiscal 2024/25, about 36 percent (1.25 of 3.46 million, input row ocean_park_non_local_visitors_fy2024_25). High is not anchored and is an assumed 75 percent. The non-local count includes mainland visitors, which the model treats as international visitors.
status: generalized (Hong Kong Disneyland FY2019 base; Ocean Park FY2024/25 low; high not anchored)

basis: No comparable value in the project sources. Share of international visits that are new to Thailand or to its tourism spending. Placeholder for the segment study.
Share of gross spending moved from other Thai destinations or activities. The low case is the highest displacement. No source in the project sources. Placeholder for the segment study.
No sourced spending per visit. The TAT and Ministry of Tourism and Sports spending figures are pending in the input table. Values are placeholders for the spending study.
Share of net spending that stays in the Thai economy after imports and leakage. Placeholder for the economic study.

The tax base is not documented, so this is a placeholder. Base is 7 divided by 107, the tax-inclusive share of spending at the reduced 7 percent VAT rate in force from 1 October 2026 (input row vat_reduced_rate_2026_2027). High is 10 divided by 110, at the statutory 10 percent rate (input row vat_statutory_rate). Low captures no tax.

Base is Hong Kong Disneyland fiscal 2025 costs as a share of revenue: (8694 minus 536) divided by 8694, which is 0.9383. Low is Ocean Park fiscal 2024/25 costs as a share of revenue: (1288.1 plus 274.7) divided by 1288.1, which is 1.2133. High is not anchored and is an assumed 0.70. Both anchors are total costs implied by net profit or loss. They include depreciation, financing and tax, so they overstate cash operating cost and the operating results are pessimistic. The depreciation lines were not removed, because the full statements of both operators were not fetched. Depreciation also overlaps with the capital cost in the operator ledger, and the national ledger carries the whole operating cost of the complex, so the overlap affects that ledger too.
status: generalized (Hong Kong Disneyland FY2025 base; Ocean Park FY2024/25 low; high not anchored)

basis: Base is the Hong Kong Disneyland adult Tier 1 ticket of HK$669 (input row hk_disneyland_adult_ticket_tier1_hkd), converted at an assumed 4.3 baht per Hong Kong dollar. High is the Tier 4 peak adult ticket of HK$939 (input row hk_disneyland_adult_ticket_tier4_peak_hkd) at the same rate. Low is 25 percent below the base for discounts and resident or child pricing, a grid choice. The exchange rate is not in the input table. The 4.3 rate is derived from a non-official rate of about 33.7 baht per US dollar and an assumed Hong Kong dollar rate of about 7.8 per US dollar. Adult list prices are an upper reference for average revenue per visit.
status: generalized (Hong Kong Disneyland adult prices at an assumed exchange rate; low is a grid discount)

basis: Base 10.66 nights is an unsourced placeholder. No fetched source was located for it, and no input row backs it. High is an assumed 5 nights. Low is an assumed 12 nights. The accommodation cap is inversely proportional to this value.
No source in the project sources. Placeholder for the average number of guests in an occupied room.

Definition used by visits_from_passengers. A round trip through the same airport counts two passenger movements. A visit that uses two airports counts one movement at each. Base and low use the round trip. High uses the two-airport case.

Base is the October 2023 to September 2024 figure of 370,210 passengers at U-Tapao (input row utapao_passengers_oct2023_sep2024). That figure is secondary, and its period is not supported by its cited chain. Low is an assumed higher load and high an assumed lower load. No calendar 2024 total is sourced.

No planned addition is sourced. The EEC Office page gives 0 percent overall progress and no opening year (input rows utapao_expansion_progress_overall_percent and utapao_expansion_opening_year). Base and low are zero. High assumes a second terminal with the same capacity as the current 3.7 million passengers (input row utapao_terminal_capacity_passengers_per_year). The EEC project target of 60 million passengers per year is undated and is not used.

No source in the project sources. Placeholder for the public operating cost borne by the government after construction, such as upkeep of access roads and utilities. The primary fiscal ledger also charges the complex capital cost to the government in the construction years, using the proposal value, which is not verified. The variant without that capital cost is reported alongside.

Pattaya city hotel keys from CBRE (input row pattaya_hotel_keys_h2_2024, H2 2024), used as a proxy for the room stock that serves the complex. The complex site is not stated as Pattaya, and no Chon Buri room count is sourced (input row chonburi_accommodation_rooms_2024_or_2025 is pending). The same value is used in all three cases.
status: generalized (Pattaya city hotel keys as proxy for the Chon Buri room stock)

basis: Average occupancy of 71.0 percent from CBRE (input row pattaya_occupancy_2024_cbre), a Pattaya figure used as a proxy for the market of the complex. The period is not confirmed: the page title says H2 2024 and the quote says 2024. No Chon Buri occupancy is sourced (input row chonburi_occupancy_2024_tat is pending). The same value is used in all three cases.
status: generalized (Pattaya CBRE occupancy as proxy for Chon Buri; period not confirmed)

basis: Practical maximum average occupancy. The accommodation headroom is the free room stock up to this ceiling, rooms times (ceiling minus occupancy), floored at zero, so that the headroom is not measured to 100 percent occupancy. No source gives a ceiling. The low case uses 80 percent, close to the average of about 80 percent that Hong Kong Disneyland hotels reported in fiscal 2025 (press report of the operator results, input row hk_disneyland_attendance_fy2025). The base and high cases are assumed.
